field_descriptions.arrival_platform: The platform where the train arrives.
field_descriptions.arrival_station: The station where the train trip ends.
field_descriptions.departure_platform: The platform from which the train departs.
field_descriptions.departure_station: The station from which the train departs.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.train_name: The name of the train (e.g. The Orient Express).
field_descriptions.train_number: The unique identifier for the train.
